bootstrap.degenerate_replicates: No resampling retry; undefined AP excluded from percentile with count reported

transported: AP>prevalence AND lower95(AP-prevalence)>0 AND AP>=floor AND F1>=floor
weak: AP>prevalence AND lower95(AP-prevalence)>0 AND at least one retention floor fails
no: Otherwise: AP not demonstrably above prevalence
bootstrap_comparison: External uncertainty and difference from fixed examined development reference; does not include development selection uncertainty
calibration_diagnostic: Brier and 15 equal-width ECE/reliability bins only; never select or fit calibration
